relations: Kayla 与 Brawley：伴侣（同居同睡）——「Waking up in Brawley’s arms is hard when Vero isn’t here with us」；Brawley 把她搂进怀里「He pulls me into his chest and tucks my head under his chin」
Brawley 与 Vero：伴侣（恋人，且是唯一懂 Vero 状态的人）——Brawley 说「When he gets like this, I always know what to do for him.」「he is going to need you to be in one piece」
Vero 与 Kayla：恋人/被救者——重逢时 Vero 喊「Paper-cut princess!」并说「You’re okay. I knew you were okay.」
Ares 与 Kayla：同伴兼照料者——Ares 替她从公寓取衣「Thankfully, Ares went and got me some from my apartment」，并在她恐慌时握住她的手说「He won’t ever hurt you again.」
Cave 与 Cipher：被 Vero 认定有性关系的两人——「Cave storms over and grabs Cipher and throws him over his shoulder.」，Vero 断言「Those two are for sure banging. Neither confirmed it, but the sexual tension is there.」
numbers: Three days Vero has been missing
no one would think to look

facts.fact: Vero 已失踪「Three days」，Kayla 反复回放监控，画面始终显示他精准地走出了镜头视野
facts.anchor: He slips out of the camera’s view, clearly knowing exactly what he’s doing.

facts.fact: Brawley 承认自己不知道这次该怎么处理（以往总知道怎么把 Vero 拉回来），Kayla 解释 Vero 摘掉了自己的 microchip，只能等他自己回来
facts.anchor: He removed his microchip, which means he doesn’t want to be found.

facts.fact: Kayla 因 Cipher 点了单人份却拿走大量餐食而注意到他，Clay 由此说出 Cipher 独居、平日只待在住宅区后面自己的棚屋里修东西
facts.anchor: He ordered a lot of food for one person, so I figured he must live with someone.

facts.fact: Clay 指出 Cipher 的棚屋在监控死区之外，又不在 Khodi 打扫过的路线上，所以搜救从未查过那里
facts.anchor: It sits just outside the dead zone

facts.fact: 一行人在棚屋外听见疯笑声与 Vero 的说话声；推门进去见 Vero 拿着纸片在凳子上旋转，Cipher 背对众人站在工作台前，Cave 坐墙角，Aaron 被绑
facts.anchor: Vero is in the center of the room, holding a piece of paper and spinning around on a stool.

facts.fact: Vero 看见 Brawley 后扔掉纸片扑上去抱紧他，并高喊「Paper-cut princess!」；Kayla 拥抱后发现双手湿红全是血，随即恐慌发作
Ares 当场揭穿被抓者的真名：他不是 Luca，而是 Aaron
临走前 Vero 揪住 Aaron 的头发逼他睁眼，告诉他「you will never see her again」，随后一刀纸片划在他脸上
facts.anchor: Take one last look, because you will never see her again.
